Like your edit says, it's because you're saving the file with an .html extension as opposed to .php extension.

It has nothing (directly) to do with PHP or the PHP version. By default Apache will not hand .html files to your PHP server/module for processing. It is possible to change that, but I would recommend against it. It is very uncommon to allow PHP to actually process files with the .html extension.
